label: H.R. 9603

latest_action.text: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 20 - 16.

selection.reason: Impact scored and summarised by Gemini.

summary: H.R. 9603, the "Less Bureaucracy, Better International Education Oversight Act," transfers certain international and foreign language education programs from the Department of Education to the Department of State. It moves related personnel, funds, and authorities, repeals the Institute for International Public Policy, and directs the Office of Management and Budget to ensure no net increase in federal full-time equivalent employees.

affected_groups.effect: Assumes management authorities, personnel, funding, and administrative duties for international education and foreign language studies programs.
Transfers away its functions, personnel, assets, and funding related to Title VI international education programs and the Fulbright-Hays Program.
Must oversee personnel caps, determine transferred functions if necessary, make incidental dispositions, and certify compliance to congressional committees.

key_provisions: Transfers international education programs in higher education (such as National Resource Centers and Foreign Language and Area Studies Fellowships) and the Fulbright-Hays Program from the Department of Education to the Department of State.
Repeals Part C of title VI of the Higher Education Act of 1965, which establishes the Institute for International Public Policy.
Transfers all personnel, assets, liabilities, contracts, property, records, and unexpended appropriations associated with the transferred functions to the Secretary of State.

Requires the Director of the Office of Management and Budget to ensure the act does not create a net increase in full-time equivalent employees at the affected agencies and to certify compliance to specified congressional committees.
Protects existing legal documents, ongoing proceedings, pending applications, and active lawsuits related to the transferred functions so that they continue as if the act had not been enacted.
missing_information: The specific number of personnel and dollar amounts of appropriations being transferred are not stated in the source text.
The exact criteria or process the Office of Management and Budget will use for incidental transfers are not detailed beyond broad statutory authorization.
summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 9603, the "Less Bureaucracy, Better International Education Oversight Act," transfers certain international and foreign language education programs from the Department of Education to the Department of State. It moves related personnel, funds, and authorities, repeals the Institute for International Public Policy, and directs the Office of Management and Budget to ensure no net increase in federal full-time equivalent employees.
summary_detail.significance: This bill shifts administrative control of federal international higher education and foreign language programs between two federal executive departments while maintaining existing funding levels and legal protections for pending applications.
